metadata.investigationConclusion: Not resolved by any other task. member photo has exactly one commit (ae773ba38 / PR #1038, issue-983). No variant/resize/transcode code exists (grep matches were 'invariant' substrings only). No Cloudflare Images / Image Resizing / cdn-cgi/image adoption. The root concern (single full-res object up to 256KB served at all sizes) is real and unaddressed; current PhotoUploadAffordance uploads the raw File with no client resize, MemberAvatar renders the single image at sm/md/lg. Original 3-option ADR is constrained by the project free-tier invariant (specs/08-free-database.md): Cloudflare Images and Image Resizing are paid → out; client-side Canvas resize is free → chosen. Issue optimized to current code as a client-side variant pipeline. Issue #1030 remains CLOSED (spec authored without reopen).
